concerns.text: Task T035 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but runs the full end‑to‑end pipeline (`python -m src.run_pipeline`). This task writes and reads the same data artefacts produced by many other tasks, so concurrent execution would cause race conditions and nondeterministic results. The `[P]` tag is therefore inaccurate.

Task T036 is also tagged `[P]` yet updates `docs/quickstart.md`. Modifying documentation while other tasks are generating artefacts can lead to file‑write conflicts and inconsistent documentation. The task is not parallel‑safe.

The Constitution (Principle VI) mandates an uncertainty‑calibration report (`data/results/calibration_report.json`). No task in the current list produces this file. Consequently the required artifact is missing, breaking the data‑flow and the non‑functional requirement for calibrated GPR uncertainty.
